title: OpenWiki Per-Project Configuration
description: Project-level overrides for the OpenWiki CLI used by PawCrew's lore-cat plugin. Values here take precedence over ~/.openwiki/.env.

modelId.description: Model ID passed to openwiki via --modelId. Examples: openai/gpt-5.6-luna, google-vertex/gemini-3.5-flash.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Maps to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL.

apiKey.description: API key for the configured provider. Maps to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY. Keep secret; do not commit plain keys.
